values.note: $35 a night including electric, for one unit and up to 8 people with two vehicles; a second camping unit pays double ($70). Weekly $200, monthly $500, yearly $1,500 (occupant pays electric). The page gives no year. Read 2026-11-11.

fees.source: https://www.owensplacervpark.com/rates--rules.html ('$35.00 per night (includes electric)'; 'Single Occupancy is defined as a group of eight people or less with up to two motorized vehicles'; 'Double Occupancy $70.00'; '$1,500.00 per year (occupant pays electric)') + reservations.html ('Overnight Rate: $35.00'), read 2026-11-11

note: Small private RV park on Hwy 38 at Marcell in the Chippewa National Forest, its sites set around a wooded loop and a small beaver pond; across the highway from Marcell's town park. Water runs May 1 to October 15; late-season sites have none. --Claude
summary: Operator site read: 32 full-hookup sites (not 22), $35 nightly incl. electric (also weekly/monthly/yearly), showers, reserve by phone/form, self-pay envelopes, water May 1-Oct 15. Cleared the aggregator-sourced 40-ft max and pull-throughs. Google 4.7 (12). Passes price and presence; long-stay character noted.
flags: Price gate: $35 a night including electric, posted on the operator's own site (no year shown); under US$50. Good Sam: not in the entry. Google 4.7 from 12 reviews (review text did not load in the browser).
Presence passes: working website with phone 218-398-3219 (Google lists the same number and website).

Long-stay tests: the operator leads with 'Daily · Weekly · Monthly · Yearly' and sells yearly sites at $1,500, but it POSTS a nightly rate ($35) and runs a self-pay envelope system for daily campers, so test 2 passes and nightly sale is real (test 4 likely passes; occupancy not measurable, no booking engine). On imagery (autumn) about 20 RVs sit on the loop, consistent with monthly/yearly occupants. Not read as mostly seasonal, but borderline in character: AWH may want a look.

Phones: the operator's pages give two numbers: 218-398-3219 ('Make reservations ... by phone: 218-398-3219') and, in the footer and on the reservations page, 307-331-2277 ('call 307-331-2277'). Stored 218-398-3219 is fine.

Waterfront lead (not changed): the operator's map draws sites 26-32 along the south side of the loop facing a beaver pond/wetland. On imagery the open water is a small pond (~0.4 ha, about 47.5864,-93.6743) with grass and brush between it and the nearest campers (~30 m). Under 5 acres is a pond and there is no pond-view; a 'pond' value would need sites 26-32 placed on open ground to it, which the drawing and imagery do not settle. Keep not waterfront.
Pin 47.58740,-93.67530 is on the north loop among the campers: OK.
Season: stored year_round false (from the old note) left; the operator says water is off after October 15 but rents 'late season' sites, and states no closing date.
